answer: New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 53 epochs rather than arriving at once. Farming becomes a relic bet on surviving 53 epochs of grading, and every hollow settlement recomputes the falcon schedule, so an hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. A fresh alias is therefore worth nothing for 10 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
